Olga — see guidance below (legal counsel):

1) Additional insured (AI) wording
- Acceptable: request CG 20 10 (or equivalent) endorsement to add 'Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and affiliates' as additional insureds with respect to liability arising out of the operations of Acme.
- Avoid open-ended 'and affiliates' without identifying Redwood — include Redwood by legal entity name where possible.

2) Waiver of subrogation
- We can accept waiver of subrogation on Workers' Comp and Employers' Liability if carrier confirms it does not void coverage and provides evidence. Preferred by us but must be listed on the COI/endorsement.

3) Retroactive date / professional liability (PI/tech E&O)
- We require a retroactive date no later than the effective date of the Order Form / PoC start date. Ideally retroactive to policy inception or 'prior acts' coverage. If broker cannot provide retroactive, we can accept a 6–12 month look-back with an exec exception but legal needs to review.

4) Primary and non-contributory
- Request primary and non-contributory endorsement (if carrier willing) for GL/Auto where available.

5) Proof and timing
- Ask broker to provide: COI naming Redwood as listed above, copies of AI endorsement (CG 20 10/CG 20 37 or equivalent), and endorsement language for primary/non-contributory. Digital PDF evidence is fine; prefer carrier-signed endorsement.

Procurement action: have broker furnish documents and confirm timeline. If they can't provide specified endorsements, ask for an escalation path to their underwriter.

I'll mark as standard for this class of customer; if anything material differs we'll escalate.

— Aditya (Legal)
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: AddlInsured-Endorsement-Req.docx (docx)
